blocks.text: Electrons ko apne mehwar (axis) ke gird ghoomta samjha jata hai, jaise zameen ghoomti hai. Electromagnetic nazariye ke mutabiq ghoomta charge maqnatisi maidan paida karta hai, aur yeh harkat electron ko maqnatis ki tarah bartao karwati hai. Do mumkin ghoomne ki harkatein hain, ghari-war (clockwise) aur ghari ke ulat (anticlockwise), to spin ka khayal rakhne ke liye chautha quantum number, electron spin quantum number s, lagaya gaya, jis ki qeematein +1/2 aur -1/2 hain. Clockwise spin oopar ki taraf teer se aur doosra neeche ki taraf teer se zahir hota hai. Har orbital zyada se zyada do electrons rakh sakta hai, basharte dono ke spin ulte hon. To ek orbital bayan karne ke liye teen quantum numbers lagte hain, magar us mein reh sakne wale do electrons mein farq karne ke liye chautha.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain
blocks.text: nth principal quantum number mein n subshells hain jo n squared orbitals par mushtamil hain aur zyada se zyada 2n squared electrons rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Helium ke 1s orbital mein do electrons hain. Har ek ke chaar quantum numbers likhein aur batayein ke kya mukhtalif hai.
blocks.explanation: Dono ke n = 1, l = 0 aur m = 0 hain, kyunke woh ek hi orbital mein hain. Farq sirf spin ka hai: ek ka s = +1/2 aur doosre ka s = -1/2, to un ke spin ulte hain, jo do electrons ko ek orbital baantne deta hai.

items: Spin quantum number s +1/2 (teer oopar) ya -1/2 (teer neeche) hai; ghoomta electron maqnatis ki tarah bartao karta hai.
Orbital zyada se zyada do electrons rakhta hai, aur sirf ulte spins ke saath; teen quantum numbers orbital tai karte hain, chautha electron.
